I have been farming rice here in Mwanza for many years, and with 6.68 hectares in total I also keep some cattle, so I will spread manure on this plot before the rains come. I will buy a couple of bags of urea through the input subsidy program to help the rice grow well, but I will plant my own saved seed from last season because the improved varieties are costly and not always available in the shops. My family will do most of the work by hand-hoe and hand-weeding, but I will hire a few extra people when it is time to harvest because that is when we need many hands quickly.
